title: Miniscript behind a timelock or one hash check

schema.around: sane miniscript, or a lone OP_TRUE
schema.also: a lone uncompressed key behind those checks, in P2SH only

note: The check matches only a lone OP_TRUE with a small number, CSV or CLTV, and DROP, before the OP_TRUE or after it. It is not a miniscript parser, and it does not match a hash lock or a bare key. The same bytes also appear in JoinMarket and Boltz, so this row does not insert an Ark package.
